identity.fantasy: A primal grove champion who heals by striking enemies, then channels elemental spirits, sacred ground, and ancient forms into party-wide offense and recovery.
identity.one_line: Hammer of Life makes melee attacks heal allies and damage enemies, while Spirits of Life, Grove effects, and elemental infusions expand that conversion. Ancient of War and Ancient of Lore offer different party-amplification forms, and the tree brings both raid haste and a damage aura. It is a genuine hybrid rather than a passive buff bot.

mechanics.core_loop: Attack through Hammer of Life to convert melee pressure into healing, build and spend Spirit Charge, maintain Grovekeeper's Presence and elemental infusions, place Ring of Life or Sacred Grove for group events, and choose Ancient of War or Ancient of Lore for the party's current offensive or healing need.
mechanics.single_target: Maintain Hammer of Life contact, use Spirit Charge and empowered hammers, and weave direct support cooldowns without abandoning melee uptime.
mechanics.aoe: Seismic Wave, Elemental Cascade, Ring of Life, Sacred Grove, and short-cooldown healing damage let the spec support large pulls while fighting inside them.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Primalist movement and instant abilities help it stay connected, but losing melee contact reduces both damage and healing conversion.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Plate armor, rage-based healing, Sacred Grove, Protector's Hand, bindings, and elemental defensive infusions make the hybrid unusually durable.
mechanics.group_utility: Haste, healing effectiveness, hit, armor, enemy armor reduction, attack power, mana regeneration, damage auras, and Ancient forms create a broad support portfolio.

failure_modes.text: Losing melee uptime suppresses both personal damage and Hammer of Life healing, while choosing the wrong Ancient form misaligns the party window.
Movement or a target swap can interrupt the intended payoff: primalist movement and instant abilities help it stay connected, but losing melee contact reduces both damage and healing conversion.

Spending recovery or control too early leaves less protection for the next pressure event: plate armor, rage-based healing, sacred grove, protector's hand, bindings, and elemental defensive infusions make the hybrid unusually durable.

append_claims.text: Recent players describe Grovekeeper as an Enhancement-Shaman-like melee healing support with strong AoE damage, damage-driven healing, plate durability, and buffs covering haste, healing effectiveness, hit, armor, armor reduction, attack power, and mana regeneration. Reports include successful dungeon healing and large solo pulls.
append_claims.notes: Output claims are anecdotal; the playstyle description aligns with current talents.

append_claims.text: The August Mythic inventory lists 175 Grovekeeper records. The DPS compilation's 2,274 value is a support/off-role signal and does not capture healing or buff contribution.
append_claims.notes: Community label Grovekeeper maps to current dataset name Life.

append_claims.text: Because Hammer of Life couples offense and healing, forced melee downtime reduces two contribution lanes simultaneously; mistimed Ancient forms can additionally waste a party-wide window.
Life is described as a melee healer using Seismic Wave on cooldown and Wild Claw, with conflicting reports about whether its full-healer ceiling depends on later talents and player execution.
append_claims.notes: Manually reviewed on 2026-08-06; anecdotal evidence is not treated as a power ranking.
